text:
Samir K: taking over overnight shift now. primary = me, secondary = Maya Chen. passing context: high traffic on inference-hosting today, saw a 504 spike this afternoon (root cause suspected autoscaler misconfig + rollout). i’ll keep an eye on latency dashboards.
Maya Chen: thanks — i'm on backup, reachable via PD. do you have the quick access checklist? i couldn't find the Grafana panels earlier.
Samir K: putting checklist here. quick access + escalation notes:
- PagerDuty: rotation 'infra-prod-ops' — primary: Samir K, secondary: Maya Chen. escalation policy: Infra-Prod-Escalate (3m -> paging). check on-call roster: https://pagerduty.com/rotations/infra-prod-ops
- PagerDuty sanity: open PD and confirm you can trigger test page. command (if you're locked to SSO): `pd user add --email maya@example.com` - only ops can do this.
- AWS: need to assume `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOncall` for console/cli. quick assume: ```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOncall --role-session-name oncall-sess
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...\nexport AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...\nexport AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=...```
- Grafana: dashboards saved under `Redwood / Runtime / Inference Latency`. make sure you have org role 'Viewer' at minimum, and team 'oncall' membership for alerting. Link: https://grafana.company.internal/d/abcd1234/inference-latency
- Runbooks: /runbooks/latency-spike.md and /runbooks/autoscaler-hotfix.md (please use runbook steps 1-6, escalate to SRE if step 3 fails)

ops-bot: automated nightly credentials check completed. 3 warnings found: 1) Maya Chen missing `oncall` Grafana team membership, 2) Alex P has soon-to-expire MFA device alert, 3) service-account `batch-ingest` credentials rotated 2d ago.
Samir K: @Maya Chen — looks like the bot flagged a membership gap. can you confirm you can view the latency dash?
Maya Chen: i just tried, getting 403 on grafana link. i can open PD fine. i don't have AWS assume role either — i get AccessDenied when running assume-role.
Alex P: i can grant you the Grafana team membership now, but i'd need confirmation from Jordan (approver) for the role binding.
Jordan L: approving — go ahead Alex, add Maya to `oncall` team. also Samir, elevate PD test to send a practice alert now so Maya gets it after membership added.
Alex P: done — added Maya to Grafana `oncall` team. also re-synced SSO groups. Maya, refresh and try again.
Maya Chen: ✅ can view dashboards now. thanks. PD test?
Samir K: sending PD test to infra-prod-ops (will be non-critical test). incident-bot: please annotate test page.
incident-bot: [automated] PagerDuty test alert sent to infra-prod-ops at 2024-11-08T02:19:24Z. Note: test -> no escalation triggered.
Maya Chen: got the page. :thumbsup: all set for PD + Grafana. still can't assume AWS role — same AccessDenied.
Alex P: popping into IAM — looks like Maya doesn't have the permission `sts:AssumeRole` for the role. i'll open a quick PR to the terraform module to add `aws:PrincipalOrgID` mapping for SSO group `oncall`. will request Jordan's review.
Jordan L: review welcome, please keep changes scoped (SSO group only). if PR blocks, we can add a short-term inline policy. Samir — any immediate need for Maya to have AWS tonight?
Samir K: not critical for tonight but useful if we need to repro on a private cluster. i'll own any CLI steps that need the role for the first 4 hours. if something requires both, we'll escalate.
Alex P: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-iam/pulls/248 — pinged Jordan for review.
ops-bot: terraform plan shows a delta: +1 group-to-role binding for `oncall` SSO group.
Maya Chen: thanks team. one more check — can someone confirm PagerDuty escalation contact list for customer-impact pages? want to be sure support is notified if it becomes P1.
Samir K: support escalation mapping: PD service `customer-facing` joins alert via `alert forwarding` after 10m or manual > severity escalate. slide: /docs/paging/customer-escalation.md . Manual steps in runbook.
Alex P: pro tip — if we need to mute noisy non-customer alerts, use PD maintenance mode for service `ingest-batch` rather than silencing alerts in Grafana.
Maya Chen: noted. thanks Samir/Alex/Jordan. i'll stay reachable. ping me on PD or DM if anything comes up.
Samir K: wrapping up: primary/secondary set, Grafana membership fixed, PD test successful, AWS role PR in flight. i'll update this thread if anything changes through the night.
Jordan L: great handoff, Samir. everyone: if you see anything odd, call out early. :eyes:
Alex P: one last: documented the assume-role step in the oncall wiki: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/oncall-credentials.md — includes troubleshoots for SSO MFA.
Samir K: thanks — closing handoff. good luck all. :coffee:
